label: conj:qou-motivic-galois-instance
title: QOU $\mathrm{MotivicGaloisCharacter}$ instance via Habiro $\to \mathrm{Frob}_p$
html:
QOU MotivicGaloisCharacter instance via Habiro evaluation

Conjecture. The QOU brane-tower substrate carries a concrete instance of def:motivic-galois-character constructed by the Habiro evaluation map:

  \mathrm{Frob}_p \;=\; f(u) \big|_{u = \zeta_{2p}}
  \;\in\; \mathbb{Z}[\zeta_{2p}].

Here f(u) = \sum_{m \geq 0} a_m(u) (u; u)_m represents the Habiro cyclotomic expansion of the atomic Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w, q) and u = q^{1/2}. The cyclotomic Pochhammer (u; u)_m vanishes for m \geq 2p. This forces the sum to terminate after a finite number of terms.

The finite-place compatibility checks, the downstream consumers, and cross-prime coherence are recorded in the follow-on remark; the per-cell \mathrm{Frob}_p data appears in the accompanying example.

Why this is stated as a conjecture (2026-08-23). The formula above specifies \mathrm{Frob}_p in \mathbb{Z}[\zeta_{2p}], one prime at a time. What def:motivic-galois-character asks for is a single \mathrm{frobenius\_at} \colon \mathrm{Primes} \to \widehat{M}, so the content of the claim is that these per-prime evaluations cohere into one \widehat{M}-valued function. The follow-on remark argues that coherence structurally from the Habiro theorem; it is neither proved nor formalised. Calling this a definition asserted the construction was already in hand.

Lean status (2026-08-23). There is no Lean formalization of this instance. The co-located .lean file — which contained a bare axiom laundering the perpetual obstruction into the MotivicGaloisCharacter class — was deleted on 2026-08-12 and has no replacement. The lean.ref this block carried until today, QOU.LiftingDescent.QOUInstance.qouMotivicGaloisChar, named a module and a declaration that exist nowhere in the Lake tree.

What does exist is lean/QOU/LiftingDescent/MotivicPerpetualObstructionFromTrace.lean (Route A: prime-ideal-collapse, C = a_0(-1) + 2 a_1(-1), sorry-free), and it is a different result: it proves statements about the obstruction, and constructs no MotivicGaloisCharacter. The 2026-08-12 note here read as though it were the replacement.
